reconcile.note: Gill reads 'God raised him' as the usual ascription to the Father, without excluding Christ's own agency or the Spirit's, so John's self-raising claim need not conflict.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Bart Ehrman reads 'God raised Jesus' as the earliest resurrection formula, with John's self-raising claim reflecting a later, higher Christology rather than one fixed agent.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Bart D. Ehrman (2014), How Jesus Became God.

sides.snippet: in three days I will raise it up
sides.verseText: Jesus answered them, \"Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.\"
whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.
